question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hind
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hind"** means situated at the back or rear; it often refers to the posterior part of something. (पीछे का भाग)

 
 
• **Example: **The hind legs of a horse are usually very strong.
 
 
 
• **"Rear"** refers to the back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; it is synonymous with hind. (पिछला भाग)
 
 
• **Example: **The rear door of the car was left open.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fore** (आगे का): Situated at the front.

 
 
• **Example:** The fore part of the ship hit the iceberg.
 
 
 
• **Anterior** (पूर्व का): Nearer to the front, especially situated in the front of the body or nearer to the head.
 
 
• **Example: **The anterior part of the brain is responsible for many higher functions.
 
 
 
• **Ventral** (पेट की ओर का): Pertaining to the abdomen or the front side of the body.
 
 
• **Example:** The ventral fins of the fish help in stability while swimming.
